title: ID0400912-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / R0 170002784] Unable to charge Volvo Truck
description:

Solution: FW1.4.11 stop the charging attempts after 100% SOC
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: No
Warranty Status:
Active till 11/6/2025

additional_info.subject: RE: AW: AW: AW: AW: ID0400912-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / R0 170002784] Unable to charge Volvo Truck CRM:02023000430
additional_info.body:
Hi Lueken,
We have checked the logs from the last four weeks and found only two EVMAC IDs that successfully charged with the charger.
We also observed a high number of failed sessions, with the primary reason being SLAC failure.
During these failed sessions, the Pilot State was toggling between B > E > B.
One possible root cause of the SLAC failure could be an improperly connected cable. A loose connection can lead to SLAC failures.
In many cases, when the user disconnects and reconnects the cable properly, the session starts normally, and the charger begins charging.
Could you please inspect the cable plug for any dust or damage and check if the cable pins are in good condition? Additionally, please examine the vehicle socket for any issues.
Ensure that both the connector and the socket are not loose. If possible, sharing pictures of the cable plug and vehicle socket would be helpful for our analysis.
If not possible please let us know, we will inform our service team to visit the site and investigate.
Thank you
Best Regards,
Vishal Dhiman
eMobility Support Team
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.

additional_info.subject: Analysis - Suspect EV issue ("00.16.81.0e.f4.f2") - Part 2
additional_info.body:
Analysis Summary:
Customer is mostly having issue with EV
"
00.16.81.0e.f4.f2
" on both outlets, mostly on DC2.
On DC1 EV "
00.16.81.0e.f4.f2
" is having issues mostly during Cable Check, but on DC2 it fails during Charge Parameter Discovery.
I have checked Jan 9th and 10th sessions where it fails during Cable Check, and I noticed a lot of QA09-10 and QA21-22 messages like these, and after this the session failed.
Sometimes, it reaches the Cable check test voltage within 39-40 seconds but fails with an error ""code":40,"msg":"V2G - message response sending failed V2G09MSGSequence_V2G09Session_V2G09Session_Charging_V2G09CableCheck_V2G09CCHProcessRequest_V2G09CCHProcessRequest_OK"".
But this EV not always fail at Cable Check but sometimes pass it and go to Charging and works fine.
Customer used EV "
00.18.23.b1.bf.72
" very less with the DC1, mostly on DC2 and worked fine on both.
Customer used EV
"
00.16.81.0e.f4.f2
" on both DC1 and DC2 almost same, and had a lot of issues.
So I suspect that there might be an issue from the EV side.
I also doubt the contactors QA09-10 and QA21-22, but not sure, sometimes it works sometimes not.
